description: Transcribes a public YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X/Twitter, Facebook video from its URL and returns the transcript. Spends credits from the user's FastScribe balance (see get_pricing_and_limits). Private or restricted videos fail and are not charged.

format.description: text: plain transcript. timestamped: one line per sentence with [m:ss]. srt: subtitle file.

language.description: Spoken language code such as "en" or "es". Omit to auto-detect.
